notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.14.1.

Small floating bubble removed
- The little round "Z" bubble that appeared when the app was minimized is gone.
- Printing switches: General Settings > Printing lets the admin turn each print on or off - KOT, cancel slips, delivery bill, bill after payment, waiter table bill, waiter customer copy and shift report.
- A cancel slip is never printed when its switch is OFF; the kitchen still sees the cancellation on its screen.
